evidencePolicy: Rules are tutorial decision support, not scientific measurements or automated safety certificates.

playbooks.title: No EIT transparency window
playbooks.symptom: The probe transmission is smooth or absorption dominates; an EIT contrast cannot be identified.
checks: Record raw probe scan, scan direction and laser frequencies; do not use a cropped plot.
Verify both laser locks and cell temperature, 780/480 nm beam overlap and relative propagation.
Compare coupling-off, coupling-on with RF off, and dark detector references using identical gain.
Check photodiode/oscilloscope bandwidth, clipping and scan time base.
Only after optical controls pass, compare with a state-specific RydIQule weak-probe model.
playbooks.acceptance: Expected: a reproducible coupling-dependent optical feature, with recorded detunings, not merely an RF-port peak.

playbooks.title: RF source peak at the wrong frequency
playbooks.symptom: An unexplained 1.5–2.4 GHz feature appears or changes without matching the synthesiser setting.
checks: Measure source into a calibrated 50 Ω spectrum reference with attenuation and correct RBW.
Disable RF, coupling laser and bias current independently to isolate electronics/optics.
Check cable coupling, harmonic leakage, compression, aliasing and acquisition sampling.
Repeat with changed source frequency/power and verify the feature tracks a lawful transition.
Only assign an atomic line after laser-state/Zeeman selection rules and full optical controls.
playbooks.acceptance: Expected: independently verified carrier/artefact attribution and RF-off optical baseline.

playbooks.title: No circular Stokes coordinate
playbooks.symptom: A strong linear angle sweep exists but S3 cannot be reconstructed.
checks: State the time-sign and propagation convention for Jones and Stokes.
Verify an actual handedness-sensitive reference channel or analyser state exists.
Calculate A rank and singular values with the exact six source states and normalisation.
Test physically known ±circular and elliptical input states, not only equator points.
Avoid treating simulated rank four as proof of optical atomic S3 measurement.
playbooks.acceptance: Expected: a calibration that separately responds to +S3 and −S3 and passes holdout cases.

playbooks.title: HFSS mesh converged but recovery fails
playbooks.symptom: An AEDT adaptive convergence flag passes while finite field/Jones calibration transfer fails.
checks: Reopen exact .aedt and geometry/state version; record solver, boundary and excitation reference.
Check independent adaptive mesh settings and physical cell observation ROI.
Export complex Ex,Ey/Ez at matching physical points, both input bases and each mask.
Compare A-matrix norm and cross-mesh heldout Stokes errors in both directions.
Keep the historical finite failure visible; do not quote periodic 0.551% as finite transfer.
playbooks.acceptance: Expected: rank four plus separately passing complex-field, gain/conditioning and transfer gates.

playbooks.title: ARC transition looks plausible but cannot be excited
playbooks.symptom: An RF dipole pair appears strong but the optical 780/480 nm ladder is inaccessible.
checks: Write n,l,j,mj,F,mF where appropriate for every optical and RF state.
Calculate actual optical transition wavelengths and measured laser coarse/fine ranges.
Enforce Δl=±1, parity, Δm=q and field quantisation-axis conventions.
Check dipole strength and lifetime/thermal mixing with explicit ARC version.
Reject candidate or document extra required lasers/spectroscopic state changes.
playbooks.acceptance: Expected: fully labelled accessible ladder and physically allowed RF neighbour with source values.

playbooks.title: RydIQule numerical solution fails
playbooks.symptom: Density-matrix steady state is singular, unstable or inconsistent with expected limits.
checks: Reduce to official three-state Sensor benchmark and documented units.
Check couplings, decay/dephasing paths and that the driven system has a unique steady state.
Verify trace-one/positive populations and solver dimensional conventions.
Add Doppler classes and actual Rb-87 Cell parameters only after simple regression passes.
Test coupling-off and RF-off limits, then compare measured optical observable.
playbooks.acceptance: Expected: stable, physical density-matrix and source-linked optical observable.

playbooks.title: Polariser reports contradictory extinction
playbooks.symptom: Two project figures give substantially different pass/reject values.
checks: Identify the physical grid, antenna/reference plane and measurement date for each.
Check 10 log10 for power vs 20 log10 for voltage under equal impedance.
Verify frequency, source power, angle, distance, gains and background subtraction.
Keep the 14–15 dB rod-grid and 9.7 dB later experiment separate.
Reproduce each from native readings; do not average across setups.
playbooks.acceptance: Expected: condition-specific contrast with units and original trace provenance.

playbooks.title: HFSS frequency bandwidth appears too good
playbooks.symptom: A reported accepted frequency span is larger than isolated verified solves.
checks: Distinguish selected discrete-frequency samples from continuously swept GHz band.
Inspect each frequency-specific mesh, complex fields, state set and gain.
Check rank, κ, S3 leverage, absolute response and acceptance thresholds at all points.
Use an independent sweep and finite geometry; do not interpolate across missing evidence.
Report sampled 250 MHz result only within its declared acceptance definition.
playbooks.acceptance: Expected: clear sampled-versus-continuous bandwidth qualification and source table.

playbooks.title: Atomic field estimate changes with coil polarity
playbooks.symptom: The receiver's apparent field shifts under reversed Helmholtz-coil current.
checks: Record actual field B vector and current, not just supply command.
Measure laser frequency/optical baseline across reversal and thermal stabilisation.
Use ARC or Breit–Rabi model for the correct selected manifold and quantisation axis.
Check source RF phase/coupling and any nearby magnetic contamination.
Separate a physical Zeeman origin from artefacts before attributing spectral lines.
playbooks.acceptance: Expected: reproducible field-dependent shift with controls and a state-specific prediction.

playbooks.title: Page plot or manuscript claim has no source
playbooks.symptom: A figure is attractive but cannot be traced to the actual run/measurement case.
checks: Find original raw oscilloscope/HFSS/derived-data filename and source hash.
Record geometry, frequency, mask, mesh, field coordinate, units and algorithm version.
Verify the plot title, axes, legends and caption match that same case.
Classify measured, HFSS-native, algebraic-derived, proposed or externally published.
Remove/mark illustrative figures if raw provenance is unavailable.
playbooks.acceptance: Expected: end-to-end claim → figure → script → original source chain.
